I Love Ducklett | POKÉTOON Short
A teenage boy and his friend Ducklett have always been together—ever since they were small! Spending time together playing, celebrating birthdays, skateboarding, and more...this quick episode captures the memorable moments the two have shared.
As some might say, the best kind of Pokémon is your very own!
